name: The Benevolent Hand: How Axiom Saved GLMZ
description: A lavishly produced Axiom-commissioned documentary tracing the corponation's role in stabilizing the Great Lakes corridor after the 2189 Cascade Failures, featuring testimonials from carefully selected Tier 3 beneficiaries and sweeping aerial reconstructions of infrastructure projects. The film systematically omits Axiom's documented forced relocation of 340,000 Shelf residents to make way for the Northlake Expansion Zone, presenting the displacement as 'voluntary community transition.' Required viewing for all Axiom employee orientation programs, it has won three licensed media awards from Vantablack-affiliated judges.
cultural_impact: Cemented the popular Tier 3 mythology that corporate expansion is inherently benevolent, a belief so thoroughly embedded that pollsters in 2215 found 61% of Tier 3 residents could not identify the Northlake Relocation as a historical event.
story_hooks: A player character discovers their own family's forced relocation is one of the omitted stories — and a raw footage archive from a deceased documentarian surfaces in a dead drop.
An Axiom orientation worker begins quietly cross-referencing the film's claims against underground records and must decide how far the truth is worth pursuing.
The film's credited director, now living in Spire-adjacent housing, contacts an underground journalist claiming the original cut was 40 minutes longer and showed something Axiom buried.
